gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mukta-vaani: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes that hold one thickness around every curve. Mukta Vaani follows with a high-waisted sans-serif lowercase, contemporary and quiet, so a long passage moves along without any fuss or fanfare.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-narnoor: Noodle-thin, confident lettering up top, with Funnel Display keeping its stroke like a fixed pen. And Narnoor, a plain sans with short ascenders over big bowls, sits beside it looking businesslike and unbothered.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-displ: Funnel Display has flat, unmodulated strokes with c tips that never drift toward touching, giving it a commanding hand. Noto Sans Display brings a big, tall middle zone in every word, and that approachable sturdiness is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-play: Rod-stock lines, bent into expressive shapes: that is Funnel Display. Play slips in a restrained thick and thin look and little height difference between cases, so a long passage reads clean and businesslike.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-port-lligat-san: Port Lligat Sans packs its characters in tight, with bowls left open on one side. Funnel Display has no hairlines to squint at, and that sturdiness against the modern, tidy plain sans is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-rambla: Strokes as constant as bent wire give Funnel Display its commanding, expressive look, with c tips that stay well apart. Shrink that heading, though, or enlarge Rambla, and the sans-serif's tall small letters would crowd it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-recursive: Recursive keeps its thickness the same in every direction, under a tall mean line. Funnel Display's wiry, commanding lettering leads above it, and a long passage in the plain sans feels approachable and modern.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-roboto-condense: Roboto Condensed runs tight, with barely visible gaps inside each word. Funnel Display's spaghetti-like strokes lead boldly above it, while the enlarged lowercase of the sans glides underneath like wire.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-saira-semi-cond: Spaghetti-like strokes with c tips that never creep toward touching mark Funnel Display. Saira Semi Condensed looks magnified without any size change, so a long passage in the sans moves along in one unvarying weight.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-secular-one: Wire-straight, expressive and commanding, Funnel Display lines up over a body whose midsection swallows nearly all the height. Secular One, a sans-serif with zero modulation, makes the pair's strength its sturdy uniformity.
